nodes.name: Generate Page Webhook
nodes.notes: responseMode is lastNode, not onReceived: the caller needs the pageUrl back synchronously so it can be dropped into the Instantly {{personalization}} merge tag before the email is queued. Expects {product, first_name, company, company_domain, contact_email, apollo_id}.

nodes.name: Get Template Variables
nodes.notes: Read live rather than hardcoded, so rewriting the template's copy in the Sendr UI never breaks this workflow. Returns an array, so n8n emits one item per declared variable — the next node folds them back together.

nodes.name: Generate Sendr Page
nodes.notes: Generates a page. It cannot send anything and cannot enrol anyone into a sequence — Sendr has no add-lead-to-campaign endpoint, so campaign enrolment stays a human action in the Sendr UI. The page renders async; page:done arrives on VIO-sendr-events.
